# AI BOT CODER

> AI BOT CODER builds custom AI automation for small and medium businesses — based in Fort Lauderdale, FL, working remotely with clients across the US. Founded by Jason Eid. The flagship product is a 24/7 AI Phone Receptionist for dental and medical offices; the company also builds custom AI agents, document processing, workflow automation, and reporting dashboards.

## What AI BOT CODER does

- **AI Phone Receptionist** — a 24/7 AI receptionist that answers every inbound call, books appointments, answers FAQs, and transfers to staff. Optional outbound appointment-confirmation calls. HIPAA-conscious with a signed BAA. Pricing: **$499/month inbound, $599/month with outbound confirmations, $0 setup.** Live demo line: (954) 568-8788. Built for dental and medical practices.
- **Custom AI automation & consulting** — document processing (PDFs, invoices, contracts, blueprints), communication/follow-up automation, reporting dashboards, custom AI agents trained on a business, and workflow automation across tools like Google Workspace, Notion, and email.
